hypothesis: When revokeGrant(employee) and release(employee) execute atomically in the same block (via Safe MultiSend) with revokeGrant first, the release() succeeds and distributes the vested amount, and a subsequent same-block release attempt would revert with NothingToRelease
sub_hypothesis: With revoke first: GrantRevoked shows claimable = vested_at_T (nothing released yet). Same-tx release() then executes and mints vested_at_T. Post-revoke later-block vestedAmount reads show formula-frozen value. Later release() reverts.
adversarial_question: Does release() correctly compute vestedAmount when called in the same tx as revokeGrant, given that _effectiveTime's strict > boundary means block.timestamp == revokedAt does NOT cap the query?

timing_proof.note: Active vesting window guaranteed at time of MultiSend execution

execution_mechanism: Safe MultiSend batch — both sub-calls execute within the same Ethereum tx, same block, same block.timestamp (T)

invariants.conservation: released + claimable + canceled = total (from GrantRevoked event, before release runs)
invariants.effective_time_boundary: _effectiveTime condition is strict >: g.revoked && queryTime > g.revokedAt. When queryTime == revokedAt (same-tx), the cap does NOT apply. release() computes vested_at_T normally.
invariants.formula_freeze: vestedAmount(beneficiary) in any later block equals GrantRevoked.vested = vested_at_T
invariants.nothing_to_release: After release() executes in same-tx, g.released == vested_at_T. Any later release() call: unreleased = vestedAmount - g.released = vested_at_T - vested_at_T = 0 → NothingToRelease revert

assumptions.A2: EVM storage writes in a preceding sub-call are visible to subsequent sub-calls within the same transaction. This test depends on A2 for revokeGrant's g.revoked=true being visible to release()'s _effectiveTime call. The test result is consistent with A2 but cannot prove A2 independently.

required_proofs: createGrant tx confirmed: grant.exists == true, params match
MultiSend tx confirmed: both sub-calls succeeded in same block
GrantRevoked event emitted in same tx: vested=V, released=0, claimable=V, canceled=1000-V
release() succeeded in same tx: TokensReleased event or equivalent, minted V tokens
post-tx: release(beneficiary) eth_call reverts with NothingToRelease (g.released == vestedAmount)

safe_transactions_required.note: CRITICAL: revokeGrant must be first sub-call. Use Safe Transaction Builder to batch these two calls.

post_test_verification.expected: V (same as GrantRevoked.vested — formula frozen at revokedAt)
